SELECT SM.MESSAGE_ID, SM.MESSAGE_TYPE, SM.MESSAGE_HOST, SM.MESSAGE_FROM, SM.SUBJECT, SM.PRIORITY_LEVEL, SM.SEND_FLAG, SM.MESSAGE_SOURCE, SM.CREATION_DATE, SM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM SYS_MESSAGE SM
AND SM.MESSAGE_FROM LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{messageFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND SM.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{subject,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND SM.SEND_FLAG = #{sendFlag}
ORDER BY SM.CREATION_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM SYS_MESSAGE MSG WHERE MSG.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'EMAIL' AND MSG.SEND_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY MSG.MESSAGE_ID ASC
SELECT MSG.* FROM SYS_MESSAGE MSG WHERE MSG.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'EMAIL' AND (MSG.PRIORITY_LEVEL IS NULL OR MSG.PRIORITY_LEVEL = 'NORMAL') AND MSG.SEND_FLAG NOT IN ('Y','F','P') ORDER BY MSG.MESSAGE_ID
SELECT MSG.* FROM SYS_MESSAGE MSG WHERE MSG.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'EMAIL' AND MSG.PRIORITY_LEVEL = 'VIP' AND MSG.SEND_FLAG NOT IN ('Y','F','P') ORDER BY MSG.MESSAGE_ID
SELECT MSG.* FROM SYS_MESSAGE MSG WHERE MSG.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'SITE' AND (MSG.PRIORITY_LEVEL IS NULL OR MSG.PRIORITY_LEVEL = 'NORMAL') AND MSG.SEND_FLAG NOT IN ('Y','F','P') ORDER BY MSG.MESSAGE_ID
SELECT MSG.* FROM SYS_MESSAGE MSG WHERE MSG.MESSAGE_TYPE = 'SITE' AND MSG.PRIORITY_LEVEL = 'VIP' AND MSG.SEND_FLAG NOT IN ('Y','F','P') ORDER BY MSG.MESSAGE_ID

SELECT SM.MESSAGE_ID, SM.MESSAGE_TYPE, SM.MESSAGE_HOST, SM.MESSAGE_FROM, SM.SUBJECT, SM.CONTENT, SM.PRIORITY_LEVEL, SM.SEND_FLAG, SM.CREATION_DATE, SM.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM SYS_MESSAGE SM
AND SM.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{subject,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND SM.MESSAGE_FROM LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{messageFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND SM.SEND_FLAG = #{sendFlag}
ORDER BY SM.CREATION_DATE DESC

select sm.*, (select smr.MESSAGE_ADDRESS from sys_message_receiver smr where smr.message_id = sm.message_id) as mobile_phone, smt.last_update_date as send_date, smt.transaction_message as transaction_message from sys_message sm,sys_message_transaction smt
smt.transaction_id=(select max(smt2.transaction_id) from sys_message_transaction smt2 where smt2.message_id=smt.message_id) and sm.send_flag='0' and smt.transaction_status != 'S' and sm.message_type = 'SMS' and sm.message_id=smt.message_id
AND (select smr.MESSAGE_ADDRESS from sys_message_receiver smr where smr.message_id = sm.message_id) like concat('%',concat(#{mobilePhone},'%'))
and trunc(smt.last_update_date) >=to_date(#{sendedDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND to_date(#{sendedDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')>=trunc(smt.last_update_date)
AND to_date(#{submitDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')>=trunc(sm.creation_date)
AND trunc(sm.creation_date)>=to_date(#{submitDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
order by 1 desc

select sm.*, (select smr.MESSAGE_ADDRESS from sys_message_receiver smr where smr.message_id = sm.message_id) as mobile_phone, smt.last_update_date as send_date, smt.transaction_message as transaction_message from sys_message sm,sys_message_transaction smt
smt.transaction_id=(select max(smt2.transaction_id) from sys_message_transaction smt2 where smt2.message_id=smt.message_id) and sm.send_flag='1' and smt.transaction_status = 'S' and sm.message_type = 'SMS' and sm.message_id=smt.message_id
AND (select smr.MESSAGE_ADDRESS from sys_message_receiver smr where smr.message_id = sm.message_id) like concat('%',concat(#{mobilePhone},'%'))
and trunc(smt.last_update_date) >=to_date(#{sendedDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND to_date(#{sendedDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')>=trunc(smt.last_update_date)
AND to_date(#{submitDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')>=trunc(sm.creation_date)
AND trunc(sm.creation_date)>=to_date(#{submitDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
order by 1 desc
select sm.message_id,sm.batch_id from sys_message sm where sm.attribute2=#{linkId}
